me.title: My appraisal
me.text: Your goals, your self review and your result, cycle by cycle.
me.empty_text: When HR opens a review cycle, your appraisal shows here.
me.not_linked: Your login is not linked to an employee
me.not_linked_text: Ask HR to link your login to your employee record.

team.title: My team
team.text: Appraisals of the people you manage.
team.empty: No appraisals of your team yet

cycles.title: Review cycles
cycles.text: Appraisal periods: who takes part and where each person stands.
cycles.open_text: Everyone working there today gets an appraisal and is told by mail. The scale and scoring rules are kept as they are now.
cycles.close_text: Nothing in it can change any more. Appraisals not finished stay as they are.
cycles.draft_note: A draft: open it to start everyone's appraisal.
cycles.empty_text: Create a cycle for a period, then open it.

editor.name: Name
editor.unit_hint: Everyone working at this place and below it when the cycle opens.
editor.fixed: This cycle is open: only the last days of its steps can change.
editor.hint: Reminders go before each step's last day (rule).

review.acknowledge_text: This closes your appraisal. You may add a comment.
review.acknowledge_done: Thank you. Your appraisal is done.
review.goals_waiting: The goals were sent; the manager approves them.
review.rate_hint_self: Rate yourself on each goal and competency, with a word on why.
review.rate_hint_manager: Rate each goal and competency. The employee sees your ratings when you send them.
review.submit_self_done: Self review sent to your manager.
review.submit_manager_done: Review sent: the employee can read the result.
review.send_back_title: Send this appraisal back a step?
review.send_back_text: It goes back one step for the person concerned to redo, with your reason. Scores worked out are cleared.

competencies.title: Competencies
competencies.text: What people are reviewed on besides their goals. Each cycle takes those in use when it opens.
competencies.empty_text: Add the usual ones (quality, teamwork, communication…) or your own.
competencies.name: Name
